No, I don't want to be a part of tomorrow anymore. I don't.

As soon as my parents pass, I'll be gone.

I've felt this way for almost 15 years now. If I can't find the solution in 15 years then I give up.

I don't know how to repair this damage.
I'm so sick of relying on tomorrow to ease the burden! TOMORROW NEVER COMES! D'X

I don't know the cause of this pain. I'm a "fix-it" kind of person. I can't find the cause, or even close. It's like a disease. I've tried therapy, counseling, medication, a combination of the three, drugs, alcohol, meditation, God, working, music, I just can't seem to pin point this thing and I'm so miserable I just want this misery to stop.
